Light: the handle is pulled taut into a peak first, then the bag comes up after it, overshoots and hangs from the peak, swinging once before it settles at the lifted height. Strong: the bag sags as the handle is gathered, is yanked higher, and swings twice from the handle before it settles at the same height. The bag stays rigid; only the handle changes from slack to taut, as in v1.

icons.name: gift-card
icons.heading: Gift card
icons.description: The gift is tied off with a flourish. Light: the ribbon is tugged, so the card dips and the loops pinch down; then the bow springs open, the loops flick up past their pose, a spark flashes out on each side, and the loops swing back once and settle as the card rebounds. Strong: two tugs, the second deeper, then a bigger spring with a fuller burst of sparks and loops that swing twice before they settle. The card stays rigid; the knot stays on the ribbon.
